summary_en: Orchestra Holdings raised FY2026 December period year-end dividend forecast from ¥30 to ¥50 per share, doubling ordinary dividend from ¥25 to ¥50. Concurrently, shareholder benefits were expanded to include holders of 200+ shares regardless of holding period, with enhanced benefits for one-year continuous holders, plus a 10th anniversary special benefit.
title_en: Notice Regarding Enhancement of Shareholder Benefit Program and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Orchestra Holdings increased its full-year dividend forecast for the December 2026 fiscal period from ¥30 to ¥50 per share, effective as of December 31, 2026. The ordinary dividend component was doubled from ¥25 to ¥50 per share, with a previously announced ¥5 anniversary commemoration dividend being consolidated into the ordinary dividend. The company stated the revision reflects commitment to stable, continuous shareholder returns beyond a one-time increase tied to the company's tenth anniversary on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Concurrently, the shareholder benefit program was expanded. Previously, benefits required holding 200+ shares for at least one year continuously. Under the new structure effective December 31, 2026, all shareholders holding 200+ shares are eligible for ordinary benefits of ¥15,000 in digital gifts, regardless of holding period. Shareholders maintaining one-year continuous holdings receive enhanced ordinary benefits of ¥16,500. Additionally, a tenth anniversary special benefit of ¥10,000 in digital gifts is provided to all 200+ share holders.

The dividend revision is conditional on approval by the ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for March 2027. The company emphasized that the increase in ordinary dividend, rather than relying solely on anniversary-related distributions, strengthens the foundation for ongoing stable shareholder returns.
